_about: Opus Vector FOC twin firmware parameters (TtParams). The same chassis as opus_vector.json with one geared FOC outrunner per wheel (DEC-02 option B) and no friction brake. Mirrors the 'Opus Vector FOC' preset (VehiclePresets.cs). Motor and drag numbers are DERIVED from that design, not measured: replace them from the V2 motor bench and the R0/R2 coast-downs.
name: opus_vector_foc
_eta_back: the sim now divides by eta when back-driven (ACT-04), so this is the true figure
_regen_n_per_ms: an FOC drive brakes on a flat current limit, not in proportion to speed
_regen_grip_cap_n: none: the allocator's ABS limits each wheel instead
_brake_max_nm: no friction brake (ACT-08): stops and holds on motor current
_drag: MEASURED in the sim: RC suite R2 coast-down fit (c0, c1); c2 from the design's Cd*A (0.0046 m^2), the fit's own being lost in the noise below 4 m/s. Agrees with the design's stated losses (c0 1.47, c1 0.14) within 3 % / 12 %. On the car: S9 coast-down.
_front_weight_frac: MEASURED in the sim (RC suite ID: wheel loads at rest). On the car: S1 corner scales.
_slip_stiffness: C_kappa/F_z, MEASURED in the sim (RC suite ID, front tyre tug of war): 19 at 1 % slip falling to 15 at 5 %; 17 is the secant at the ~3 % the mission brakes at (traced: -3 to -3.5 % after a short onset transient). On the car: S7/S10, encoder speed vs ground truth under a known torque.
